metas.name: Sye Raa Narasimha Reddy
metas.description: Gwalior Fort, during the Indian Rebellion of 1857. In a moment of despair, Lakshmibai, Rani of Jhansi, encourages her men by telling them the heroic story of Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy, a brave Telugu chieftain who took up arms in 1846 to protest against the numerous arbitrariness and crimes perpetrated by the leaders and military forces of the East India Company.

metas.name: The Ghazi Attack
metas.description: India’s first underwater war film tries to decode the mystery behind the sinking of Pakistani submarine PNS Ghazi during the India-Pakistan war of 1971.

metas.name: Kurukshetram
metas.description: The Sanskrit epic Mahābhārata told through Cinema.

metas.name: Mehbooba
metas.description: Mehbooba movie is a romantic love story in the backdrop of 1971 Indo-Pak war.

metas.name: Chanakya Chandragupta
metas.description: The film is a historical story, based on the 3rd century BC Maurya Emperor Chandragupta Maurya and his mentor Chanakya. It begins with the Greek invader Alexander intruding on our borders, Magadha as his last step of sovereignty. Discerning it, fear-defying scholar Chanakya is under trace of the dynamic King to hinder it.

metas.name: Samrat Ashoka
metas.description: The life story of emperor Ashoka.

metas.name: Sri Rama Pattabhishekam
metas.description: Sri Rama Pattabhishekam (Coronation of Lord Rama) is a 1978 Indian Telugu-language Hindu Epic film directed and produced by N. T. Rama Rao. King Dasharatha's queen Kaikeyi makes unusual demands to thwart the coronation of Lord Rama as king of Ayodhya. As a result, Lord Rama is forced to undergo several challenges.

metas.name: Bobbili Yuddham
metas.description: The story of this film revolves around the ' Battle of Bobbili ' fought between the Bobbili and the Vijayanagaram kingdoms in 1757.

metas.name: Tandra Paparayudu
metas.description: The story of an Indian Freedom fighter who fought the French even before the British could establish their authority in India

metas.name: Palnati Yudham
metas.description: When the minister of Palnadu opens the temple doors for all the castes in the kingdom, disputes arises in the kingdom leading to war.
